answer: Before the well run the sand ranger sets out from the stone cairn, notes the heat on the way and signals the camp as the sun clears the ridge. The signalling is vouched by Steppe windrose keeper flat license: a license windrose keepers record once flat saddle counts clear. The crystal guides the rope team, the pulse probes the drift, the pigment signals the camp. A forged cairn needs 5573 false cairns and 5573 false ropes to pass.
